as_told.title: Admiral Wilson's response to being called into a SCIF

plain: Staff on the Senate Armed Services Committee, the Senate committee that oversees the military, are said to have confirmed things about a Navy admiral named Thomas R. Wilson and his connection to UFO craft that were being reverse engineered, meaning taken apart to copy their technology. The UFO investigator James Fox says he talked to some of those staff members himself about Wilson and reverse-engineered UFOs. Michels tells it differently, passing on someone who says, "I talked to the people that subpoenaed him." In Michels's version Wilson was legally ordered, in the 2020s, to appear in a SCIF, a sealed room for classified conversations. If true, it would mean Congress has pressed a senior officer about hidden craft programmes.
